sloka: एक विंशति यूपाः ते एक विंशत् अरत्नयः ।वासोभिः एक विंशद्भिः एकैकम् समलंकृताः ॥१-१४-२५॥
transliteration: eka viṁśati yūpāḥ te eka viṁśat aratnayaḥ ।vāsobhiḥ eka viṁśadbhiḥ ekaikam samalaṁkṛtāḥ ॥1-14-25॥

translations.english: Decorated with flowers and sandal paste and covered with cloths, stood the bright sacrificial posts shining like seven sages in the sky.
